decision: Pulled main; branch claude/better-t-stack-setup-ihfjpo starts at 912b5f4 with no remote yet
why: the user asked to pull first

decision: Ran the Better-T-Stack scaffold in the scratchpad exactly as given; the first try with an added --yes flag was rejected by the CLI
why: the CLI refuses --yes together with stack flags

decision: Definition of done: pnpm install, typecheck, lint, format, unit and story tests and both builds pass from the root; every story renders pixel-identical to the pre-move baseline; the web app streams a reply about the slider's chosen measure through a Web Worker and reloads the conversation from SQLite in OPFS; the gateway rejects a missing token and streams with a valid one; signed-out visits redirect to WorkOS
why: the run needs a falsifiable predicate before code

decision: Rigor: high. The layout move is a one-way door for every later phase, so it gets a pixel baseline and a scripted comparison; the runtime and gateway get unit tests plus a browser run
why: wrong foundations cost every later unit

decision: No Anthropic key is present in this container, so the real-model path is verified with a fake upstream and left INCONCLUSIVE end to end
why: cannot fabricate a model run

decision: Shot all 40 stories twice from the old layout before moving anything; 6 differ between the two runs (dictation waveform, one chart animation)
why: the move must be proven pixel-identical, and the run-to-run noise had to be known first

decision: One script performs the whole move: git mv catalog-lab to packages/catalog, .storybook to apps/storybook, scaffold copies for apps/web, packages/ui, packages/config, and every config rewrite
why: a reviewer reruns one file instead of retracing 85 renames

decision: Dropped Varlock, bunfig.toml, the server entry deps and the start script from the scaffold's web app
why: ADR-083 says the SPA has no server; env is parsed once with zod at the boundary instead of a codegen step

decision: Kept isbot as a web dependency and told fallow to ignore it
why: React Router 8's typegen runs pnpm install by itself when isbot is missing, which hung turbo for 11 minutes behind the proxy

decision: Deleted 14 of the 17 scaffolded shadcn components and the loader; kept button, dropdown-menu, sonner
why: nothing imports them, fallow flags dead files, and shadcn add restores any of them in seconds
result: lint errors in packages/ui down to 2

decision: Lint runs with --disable-nested-config and the ignore lists use .agents/** and .claude/**
why: oxlint and oxfmt were picking up an example config and files under the vendored skills
result: format:check green; lint deterministic across 6 runs

decision: Lefthook replaces husky and lint-staged and runs only on staged files: oxlint, oxfmt, wrap-md
why: ADR-086 puts staged checks in the hook and everything else in CI

decision: Main is red on its own: 53 oxlint errors and 3 axe nested-interactive failures reproduce in a worktree of origin/main, and CI run 36223981104 failed on main
why: needed to know which failures the move inherits before claiming anything
result: inherited; fixed as a separate unit after the move lands

decision: After the move all 40 stories PASS; 36 byte-identical to the baseline, 1 matches the second baseline run, 3 dictation stories differ only in the live waveform bars
why: pixel proof that hosting stories from apps/storybook moved nothing

decision: Replaced the scaffold's ErrorBoundary with a two-line page: not found, or reload
why: fallow scored the scaffold's if/else chain as untested complexity (CRAP 42); React Router's dev overlay already shows stacks

decision: Formatted the two vendored oxc-config-example/.oxlintrc.json files
why: oxfmt formats any file named .oxlintrc.json regardless of ignorePatterns; only whitespace changed

decision: Renamed Kay's --accent to --olive as well as --radius to --radius-card before mapping shadcn's variables
why: shadcn's --accent is its hover fill; loading both stylesheets would have turned the slider's olive grey
result: 36 stories byte-identical, 4 animation-only diffs, web builds

decision: Kay's tokens.css loads in a catalog cascade layer between Tailwind's preflight and its utilities
why: the stylesheet styles bare buttons, links and headings; unlayered it would beat every utility on a shadcn primitive, and below preflight the catalog's own look would reset

decision: The catalog is a pure package: its index.html, share.html and entry files moved into apps/web routes (thread, lab, share.html, callback)
why: the target layout keeps components, stories, schemas and tests in one package and the pages in the app
result: route tree printed by react-router routes

decision: Build settings parse once into a union with no half-set states: agent lab or gateway, auth none or workos
why: a gateway without a URL means the site's own origin; WorkOS without its id fails at start, not on first sign-in

decision: Dropped next-themes for a 50-line theme module on data-theme
why: React 19 logs an error for the inline script next-themes renders inside a client-rendered component; the stored theme now boots from the prerendered shell's head

decision: Dark mode switches the root attribute but the page stays light
why: tokens.css themes only the attention surfaces so far (its own comment under ADR-046); full dark mode is catalog work, not shell work

decision: Browser proof of the vertical slice with the lab stand-in: card renders, slider to Net profit, the sent message carries the chip, the reply names the chosen view; lab, share and not-found routes render
why: the seam and the card-state feedback hold in the real app before the worker replaces the stand-in

decision: Registered http://localhost:5173/callback and the matching CORS origin in WorkOS through its API
why: the project had none; AuthKit in the browser needs both

decision: Browser proof of the sign-in gate: a signed-out visit to / leaves for api.workos.com/user_management/authorize with PKCE, the registered callback and returnTo in state; share.html and /callback stay public
why: ADR-084 asks for exactly this redirect; the hosted page itself cannot be completed without a person's credentials
result: 5 PASS; the hosted sign-in and token refresh remain unverified

decision: Wrapped adr.md, FOR_ETHAN.md, LATER.md and the Kay stack note at 100 columns in one style commit before adding ADR-087
why: the hook wraps any staged markdown, and 166 long lines in the ADR index would have buried the new record in whitespace

decision: ADR-087 records the layout, the scaffold pieces dropped, the two token renames, the cascade layer and the pixel proof
why: the ADR index is where Ethan reads decisions; the trail is where a reviewer audits them
result: drafted; runtime and gateway sentences follow their units

decision: Cleared core.hooksPath, which husky's prepare script had set from a throwaway worktree of main, and made pnpm install reinstall Lefthook with --reset-hooks-path
why: git had run no hook on any commit since; every commit was gated by hand instead, and the setup must converge on its own
result: hook proven on the next commit
